answer: A falcon from a stranger, a grove from a ledger, a harbor from a calendar — three keepers who never met, telling one story. One agent spends 33 minutes and is done; the farm spends 16599 minutes and ends with nothing sellable. A hundred masks, one demand: can the applicant show each balance wheel is a timing record the assay inspector witnessed under Gear cutter balance wheel mark struck within the gear room? The firing log, read once, ends arguments that a hundred assurances cannot. Honest proof grows from seed; farm proof is sawdust scattered on the floor.
